messages:
Priya (Design): Hey folks — quick microcopy + a11y check for the org switch control. Drafts below, want short and screen-reader friendly text.

Priya (Design): Tooltip: `Switch active organization`
Empty state: Heading: `No organizations yet` Body: `Create an organization to get started.` CTA: `Create organization`

Owen (PM): Love the brevity. Use `organization` to match billing/RBAC. CTA verb-first works.

Ravi (Frontend): Agree. Implementation notes: make the trigger a button with aria-haspopup="listbox" and aria-expanded toggled. Add aria-describedby to point at tooltip id. Tooltip should appear on focus/hover.

Jamie (Eng): Also avoid trailing punctuation on tooltip so VoiceOver reads it cleanly. For mobile hide tooltip until press.

 a11y-bot: Check: contrast failure on existing tooltip palette (1.3:1). Recommend text color #111827 or darker bg. Also ensure tooltip has role="tooltip" and is referenced by aria-describedby.

Priya (Design): Updated handoff note: Tooltip copy `Switch active organization` (no period). Provide tooltip id, use aria-describedby on trigger, role="tooltip". Meet WCAG contrast >= 4.5:1. Empty state as above.

Ravi (Frontend): I'll add aria-describedby and test contrast in the component.

Jamie (Eng): Adding acceptance criteria to ticket: tooltip announced on focus, visible on hover, focus ring per DS, contrast >= 4.5:1. Ready for dev after validation.

Priya (Design): Thanks — attaching updated pattern and checklist to the PR. :sparkles:
